en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 10. Ja’far ibn `Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn `Ali ibn `Abdillah ibn al-Mugheerah al-Kufi (ra) said: al-Hasan, my grandfather, ibn `Ali al-Kufi on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Sayf, on the authority of his brother `Ali, on the authority of his father Sayf ibn 'Umayrah on the authority of `Amru ibn Shimr, on the authority of Jabir bin Yazid al-Ju'fi that Abi Ja’far (al-Baqir) (as) said:
Jibra’il (as) came to Rasulullah (sw) and said: “O Muhammad! Blessed is any member of your Ummah who professes that 'There is no god but Allah, Alone, Alone, Alone.'"
